local command/I/O; solid = sync. Flow type is also written on each arrow.
Long-poll, not a pipeline step

The MCP wait tool long-polls GET /api/wait on its
own schedule (timeout clamped to 1s–600s, default
120s). The save doesn't trigger it.
Source: src/server/daemon.ts
Files mode when no daemon

With no daemon, MCP writes .vibeprint/ directly
under runtime/files.lock. After 5s of waiting it fails
with 503 'Another process is writing'. Locks older
than 10s are removed.
Source: src/mcp/backend.ts
Corrupt canvas fails closed

If .vibeprint/canvas.json won't parse (e.g. merge
conflicts) or isn't a Vibeprint canvas, the daemon
throws and asks you to restore it from git. It does
not overwrite it.
Source: src/server/canvas.ts
